title: Positive variance of a nonconstant Boolean function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be nonconstant. For every $p$ with $0<p<1$, the variance of $f$ under the product distribution on signs with $\Pr[X_i=-1]=p$ independently for each coordinate is strictly positive.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
